description: This file defines the 'Delete' feature for comments, including command validation and the handler to delete a comment from an article based on slug and comment ID.

classes.name: Delete
classes.description: Contains the command, validator, and handler for deleting comments from an article.

methods.name: CommandValidator
methods.description: Validates that the Slug field in the command is not null or empty.

methods.name: QueryHandler
methods.description: Handles the deletion of a comment associated with an article identified by Slug, removing it from the database.
